name: How long does it take to install new flooring in a typical rental apartment?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install new flooring in a typical rental apartment?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration for flooring installation depends on the type of flooring, the size of the apartment, and whether old flooring needs to be removed. For a typical two-bedroom apartment (around 1000-1200 sq ft), LVP or laminate installation can often be completed within 2-4 days, assuming proper subfloor preparation. Carpet installation is generally quicker, often 1-2 days. Complex layouts or extensive subfloor repairs can extend these timelines.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time for a typical apartment can range from 1-4 days, depending on flooring type, apartment size, and subfloor preparation requirements.
